Eximbank have taken over as official sponsor of the V-League. == Teams == [[Nam Định F.C.|Nam Định]] were relegated to the [[2011 Vietnamese First Division]] after finishing the [[2010 V-League|2010 season]] in last place. They were replaced by [[Hà Nội ACB]]. [[Navibank Sài Gòn F.C.|Navibank Sài Gòn]] defeated Than Quảng Ninh in the end of season promotion/relegation match to secure their place in the [[Vietnamese Super League|V-League]]. === Stadia and locations === {{location map+ |Vietnam pre-July 2025 |float=right |width=300 |caption=Locations of the V.League 2011 teams |places= {{location map~ |Vietnam pre-July 2025 |lat=16.066667 |long=108.233333 |label=
